info.name: Toolshop API – checkout workflow
info.description:
API tests for https://practicesoftwaretesting.com (Toolshop API v5). Run top-to-bottom: requests share state through collection variables (token, productId, cartId, invoiceId). A fresh customer is registered on every run.

CLI: npx newman run postman/toolshop-api.postman_collection.json

exec: // Unique customer per run so the collection can be re-run against the shared demo.
pm.test("Returns the created customer without password", () => {
pm.test("Password rule message", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().password.join(' ')).to.include('uppercase and one lowercase'));
pm.test("Response time < 5000 ms (sanity guard; performance is covered by k6)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(5000));
pm.test("Profile belongs to the logged-in customer", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('email')));
pm.test("Same product as in the list", () => {

item.name: 5. Defect reproduction (evidence)
item.description: Each request reproduces a reported defect. Assertions document the CURRENT (incorrect) behaviour so the run doubles as evidence; the expected behaviour is stated in the test name.

item.name: DEF-002 Checkout the same cart a second time

request.description: Expected: 4xx (cart already ordered). Actual: 201 and a second invoice.

exec: pm.test("DEF-002 reproduced – duplicate order accepted (expected 4xx, got " + pm.response.code + ")", () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test("A different invoice number was issued", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.not.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('invoiceId')));

item.name: DEF-003 b) Order the empty cart

request.description: Expected: 422 (cart is empty). Actual: 201 with total 0.

exec: pm.test("DEF-003 reproduced – order for empty cart accepted (expected 422, got " + pm.response.code + ")", () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

item.name: OBS-1 a) Create cart with 60 units

request.description: Expected: 422 or quantity capped at 99. Actual: 200.

exec: pm.test("OBS-1 reproduced – line quantity is 120 (max is 99)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().cart_items[0].quantity).to.eql(120));

item.name: OBS-3 Payment check with unknown method

exec: pm.test("OBS-3 reproduced – unknown payment method reported successful", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
